pr_body:
This PR updates our many uses of backoffs throughout the codebase to use the `cenkalti/backoff` package.

Fixes https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/6985

issue_context.title: Unify backoff retry mechanisms
issue_context.body:
## Backoff

> One such library already in use in our codebase seems to be used in Codespaces code: https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/79a1be4fe05f95a0f2b193f531ea91313668707f/internal/codespaces/codespaces.go#L48-L52

> Throughout the gh codebase, we definitely have ad-hoc implementations for this in too many places, and the implementations are not even that good. Example: https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/79a1be4fe05f95a0f2b193f531ea91313668707f/pkg/cmd/pr/create/create.go#L753-L757

_Originally posted by @mislav in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/6962#discussion_r1098846080_

## Sleep

> Testable Go code should never be allowed to sleep the same period of time in tests as it does during normal runtime. Even a relatively short duration like sleeping 100ms would make tests really slow. Finding a way to inject a shorter (fake) Duration in tests would be crucial.

> Also, the Sleep statement would not return early if a Context has been cancelled, therefore if a Context is involved, it would be better to use a Timer and use a `select` statement to react to either a Timer completing or a Context being cancelled, whichever comes first. Example: https://github.com/cli/oauth/blob/adf5f733ffd14993aad9f3ff02c757a737f7c63b/device/poller.go#L30-L37

_Originally posted by @mislav in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/6962#discussion_r1098841001_
            
## Proposal

* Replace all ad-hoc mechanisms with the `backoff` mechanism used by codespaces.
* Replace most instances of `time.Sleep()` with a polling thing that handles cancelation and makes it easier for testing to tune durations.
comments: Agreed that this is something that we should standardize. We only have retries in a couple of places in the codebase and my vote would be to replace them with the [BackOff](https://github.com/cenkalti/backoff) package.

review_comments: Nit: can we put in some whitespace to break this up a bit? It's pretty dense to read :smile:
